items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Topics 7:1
items.html: For such is the meaning of the ascent of reflected light from below upward, by reason of the coupling by striking that is made there. For the meaning of “from below upward” is opposition to clothing, that “it does not bear” the light clothing in it. (Chapter 1, Item 5)
